scenario: Supersedure per LRST.2.1 — `call ... as <expr>` uses the expression as the supersedure key; the `as` clause must appear after all action_args (cooldown, entity_id, etc.) in the call grammar. Pin: `call sensor.read entity_id: d.entity_id cooldown: 1_min as d.entity_id` compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Device scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    zone: String mutable

rule scan:
    Device d
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: d.entity_id cooldown: 1_min as d.entity_id
